questions.q: A service has low CPU but every request hangs. What is the best first step?
o: Take three thread dumps about ten seconds apart and compare them
Take a heap dump and open it in Eclipse MAT
Raise -Xmx and restart the service
Enable Native Memory Tracking on the next deploy
questions.w: Low CPU with hung requests means threads are waiting. Dumps taken over time show what they wait for. A heap dump shows memory, not waiting.

questions.q: In a thread dump, which value lets you match a thread to the id shown by top -H?
o: nid, the operating-system thread id in hexadecimal
tid, the Java thread id in decimal
prio, the thread priority number
The name of the thread pool
questions.w: top shows decimal ids, and the dump prints nid in hexadecimal, so convert with printf %x before searching.

questions.q: After every full GC the heap is a little fuller than after the last one. What does this suggest?
o: A memory leak, so take a heap dump and look at the dominator tree
The young generation is too small for the allocation rate
A deadlock between two threads holding locks
The JIT compiler has not finished warming up
questions.w: A rising heap after full GC means objects are still reachable but unused. High peaks with a flat floor point at sizing or allocation instead.

questions.q: What does retained heap tell you about an object in a heap dump?
o: The memory that would be freed if that object were removed
The memory taken by the object's own fields only
The number of references that point to the object
The memory the object used before the last GC
questions.w: Retained heap includes everything kept alive only by the object. Shallow heap is just the object itself. The dominator tree sorts by retained heap.

questions.q: A container is OOMKilled with exit code 137, but the Java heap is only 60% full. What is the likely reason?
o: Off-heap memory (threads, Metaspace, buffers) pushed the process over the limit
The garbage collector failed to run before the limit was reached
The JVM threw OutOfMemoryError and the heap dump was then lost
The heap dump flag was missing from the startup command line
questions.w: The kernel limits the whole process, and kills it with SIGKILL, so there is no Java exception. Native Memory Tracking shows which area grew.

questions.q: Which message means the JVM could not create another thread?
o: OutOfMemoryError: unable to create native thread
OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
OutOfMemoryError: Metaspace
OutOfMemoryError: Direct buffer memory
questions.w: The text after the colon names the exhausted area. A thread request refused by the operating system gives the native thread message.

questions.q: Why is Java Flight Recorder considered safe to run in production?
o: It samples data the JVM already has, so the overhead is about one to two percent
It only runs while the service is idle at night
It records every method call with full arguments
It stops all threads while it writes the recording
questions.w: JFR records sampled events instead of instrumenting each call. It can run continuously or start on demand with jcmd JFR.start.

questions.q: In a flame graph, what does the width of a box mean?
o: The share of samples in which that method was on the stack
The time order in which the method ran
The number of threads that called the method
The memory the method allocated
questions.w: Wide boxes are where time goes. The horizontal order has no meaning, so read from a wide box down to its callers.
